registration_statements: In this prospective, open-label, randomized controlled trial, we recruited patients with Covid-19 from 23 hospitals in nine provinces throughout mainland China. The study protocol has been approved by the ethics committee of each participating site. The protocol was designed based on the Good Clinical Practice guidelines and The Declaration of Helsinki , and has been registered with China Clinical Trial Registry website ( www.chictr.org/cn/ , No.: Chi CTR-TRC-2000029434). All patients signed written informed consent.
